people.name: Nebuchadnezzar
people.line: Emperor of Babylon who conquered Judah

translations.web: Nebuchadnezzar the king, to all the peoples, nations, and languages, who dwell in all the earth: Peace be multiplied to you.
translations.bsb: King Nebuchadnezzar, To the people of every nation and language who dwell in all the earth: May your prosperity be multiplied.
translations.kjv: Nebuchadnezzar the king, unto all people, nations, and languages, that dwell in all the earth; Peace be multiplied
